title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
description: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.

title: SoftBank-Backed 3D Printer Maker Formlabs Said to Weigh IPO
description: Formlabs, a maker of 3D printers, is in early talks with potential advisers for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: PGA Tour CEO Exclusive and David Kelly Talks Investing | Bloomberg Money 8/7/2026
description: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Meredith Whitney Advisory Group CEO Meredith Whitney, JPMorgan Asset Management Chief Global Strategist David Kelly, and PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp. (Source: Bloomberg)
